cs.title: Fabrikam Healthcare Global Telehealth Platform
cs.overview: Fabrikam Healthcare is building a next-generation cloud-native Telehealth and diagnostic platform in Microsoft Azure. The platform hosts high-resolution medical imaging analysis, AI diagnostic inference models, and real-time telehealth video consultations for millions of global patients.
cs.businessRequirements:
1. Operational Availability: Web frontends must maintain at least 99.95% uptime SLA.
2. Accidental Protection: Critical patient medical image storage accounts must be protected against accidental administrator deletion.
3. High Performance: High-volume NoSQL Cassandra databases handling real-time vital metrics require direct NVMe storage throughput.
4. Multi-Region DR: Prioritized recovery mechanisms must be established in the event of major regional power grid outages.
cs.technicalRequirements:
1. AI Diagnostic Models: Medical image inference requires GPU-accelerated computing.
2. Dynamic Auto-scaling: Compute workloads must dynamically scale in response to CPU metrics using Virtual Machine Scale Sets (VMSS).
3. CLI Management: Cloud engineering teams require browser-accessible, authenticated command-line management without local software installations.
4. Unified Access Control: Enterprise permissions must follow fine-grained Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
cs.existingEnvironment: Fabrikam operates a hybrid cloud connected via Azure ExpressRoute to local hospital diagnostic imaging devices with legacy unmanaged VHD storage accounts.

questions.title: CS2: Select VM Family for GPU Acceleration
questions.prompt: Which Virtual Machine series should Fabrikam select to run NVIDIA GPU-accelerated AI medical image diagnostic models?

options.text: N-Series (GPU-Enabled)
E-Series (Memory-Optimized)
L-Series (Storage-Optimized)
B-Series (Burstable CPU)

questions.explanation: N-Series VMs are equipped with NVIDIA GPUs for AI/ML inference and graphics rendering.

questions.title: CS2: Select VM Family for NoSQL NVMe Storage
questions.prompt: Which Virtual Machine series family should Fabrikam choose for high-volume NoSQL Cassandra databases requiring direct-attached local NVMe storage?

options.text: L-Series (Storage-Optimized)
D-Series (General Purpose)
N-Series (GPU-Enabled)
F-Series (Compute-Optimized)

questions.explanation: L-Series VMs feature direct-attached local NVMe storage providing high I/O throughput for NoSQL databases.

questions.title: CS2: Prevent Accidental Storage Deletion
questions.prompt: Which Azure Resource Lock should Fabrikam apply to prevent accidental administrator deletion of critical patient medical image storage accounts?

options.text: CanNotDelete Lock
ReadOnly Lock
System Lock
Subscription Lock

questions.explanation: CanNotDelete lock permits reading and modifying resources while blocking accidental deletion.

questions.title: CS2: Auto-Scaling Compute Workloads
questions.prompt: Which Azure service meets Fabrikam technical requirement to automatically scale a load-balanced pool of identical web VMs in response to patient traffic spikes?

options.text: Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets (VMSS)
Azure Storage Account Containers
Azure Entra ID Tenants
Azure Resource Locks

questions.explanation: VMSS lets you manage and auto-scale a group of identical VMs integrated with load balancers.

questions.title: CS2: Browser Command-Line Shell
questions.prompt: Which tool satisfies Fabrikam requirement for a browser-accessible, pre-authenticated command-line shell to run management scripts without local software installation?

options.text: Azure Cloud Shell
Visual Studio Code Desktop
Windows Notepad
Microsoft Outlook

questions.explanation: Azure Cloud Shell is an interactive, browser-accessible shell for managing Azure resources using Bash or PowerShell.

questions.title: CS2: Benefits of Managed Disks
questions.prompt: Which TWO advantages will Fabrikam gain by migrating legacy unmanaged VHD disks to Azure Managed Disks? (Select TWO)

options.text: Automatic Storage Management: Azure manages underlying storage accounts without VHD file limits.
High Availability Alignment: Ensures disks for Availability Set VMs are placed on distinct storage Fault Domains.
Eliminates all charges for cloud storage.
Automatically converts Linux VMs into Windows Server 2025.

questions.explanation: Managed Disks simplify storage management and align disks across distinct storage Fault Domains.

questions.title: CS2: Azure CLI Login Methods
questions.prompt: Which TWO authentication mechanisms can Fabrikam engineers use to log into Azure CLI? (Select TWO)

options.text: Interactive web browser authentication using z login.
Automated non-interactive login using Service Principals or Managed Identity in automation scripts.
Scanning a paper barcode on a physical employee badge into a webcam.
Sending an SMS text message to a landline phone.

questions.explanation: Azure CLI supports interactive browser logins and non-interactive Service Principal / Managed Identity logins.

questions.title: CS2: Subscription Functions
questions.prompt: Which TWO fundamental logical boundaries are provided by an Azure Subscription for Fabrikam environment? (Select TWO)

options.text: Billing Boundary: Grouping usage metrics and issuing separate invoices.
Security & Access Boundary: Scope for applying RBAC permissions and access policies.
Hardware RAM allocation boundary for physical datacenter racks.
Web browser cookie storage boundary for client laptops.

questions.explanation: Subscriptions serve as billing containers and security administration boundaries.

questions.title: CS2: Management Group Governance
questions.prompt: Which TWO features of Azure Management Groups support Fabrikam multi-subscription governance? (Select TWO)

options.text: Support hierarchical organizational structures up to 6 levels of depth.
Enable policy assignments and RBAC permissions to inherit down to all child subscriptions.
Store raw medical image DICOM files directly on physical disk drives.
Automatically format client PC hard drives.

questions.explanation: Management Groups support 6 levels of depth for policy inheritance across subscriptions.

questions.title: CS2: Regional Pair DR Benefits
questions.prompt: Which TWO capabilities do Azure Regional Pairs provide for Fabrikam global disaster recovery planning? (Select TWO)

options.text: Prioritized Region Recovery: Azure prioritizes recovering at least one region out of every pair during widespread outages.
Cross-Region Replication: Paired regions separated by 300+ miles protect against localized natural disasters.
Automatic conversion of SQL tables into printed paper copies.
Free lifetime subscriptions for all hospital staff.

questions.explanation: Regional Pairs provide cross-region replication and prioritized recovery during disasters.

questions.title: CS2: Match Compute Workloads to Series
questions.prompt: Match each Fabrikam telehealth component to its appropriate Azure VM series.

targets.label: NVIDIA GPU acceleration for AI diagnostic model inference.
High-throughput NoSQL Cassandra storage handling real-time vital metrics.
General-purpose web API servers with balanced CPU and RAM.
Internal developer sandbox environments with burstable CPU demand.

questions.explanation: N = GPU, L = NVMe NoSQL, D = General Purpose, B = Burstable.

questions.title: CS2: Match Azure CLI Command Groups
questions.prompt: Match each Azure CLI command group to its target resource category.

targets.label: Manage virtual machine compute instances.
Manage resource group containers.
Manage virtual networks, subnets, and IP addressing.
Manage Blob, File, Queue, and Table storage accounts.

questions.explanation: CLI groups: az vm, az group, az network, az storage.

questions.title: CS2: Match Resiliency Models to SLA
questions.prompt: Match each Fabrikam VM deployment model to its SLA uptime guarantee.

targets.label: Virtual Machines deployed across two or more Availability Zones.
Two or more Virtual Machines in an Availability Set.
Single Virtual Machine with Premium SSD or Ultra Disk.
Workload replicated across paired Azure regions 300+ miles apart.

questions.explanation: AZ = 99.99%, AS = 99.95%, Single Premium SSD = 99.90%, Pair = Cross-Region DR.

questions.title: CS2: Match Governance Mechanisms
questions.prompt: Match each Azure governance tool to Fabrikam governance objective.

targets.label: Enforce compliance rules such as restricting allowed VM SKU families.
Assign fine-grained role permissions (Owner, Contributor, Reader) to staff.
Prevent accidental deletion of production medical image storage.
Package policies, RBAC, and templates into repeatable subscription standards.

questions.explanation: Policy = Enforcement, RBAC = Roles, Lock = Protection, Blueprints = Packages.

questions.title: CS2: Match Infrastructure Concepts
questions.prompt: Match each Azure infrastructure component to its architectural function.

targets.label: Hardware rack sharing common power supply and network switch.
Group of VMs patched sequentially during planned maintenance.
Logical container for assets managed as a single lifecycle unit.
Dedicated identity boundary for user accounts and authentication.

questions.explanation: FD = Rack hardware, UD = Maintenance patch group, RG = Lifecycle, Tenant = Identity.

questions.title: CS2: TF - Update Domain Reboot Behavior
questions.prompt: True or False: Update Domains (UD) group Virtual Machines together so they can be rebooted simultaneously during planned platform maintenance.
questions.explanation: False. Update Domains patch VMs sequentially (one UD at a time) so that remaining VMs continue servicing traffic.

questions.title: CS2: TF - Management Group Policy Inheritance
questions.prompt: True or False: Fabrikam can assign an Azure Policy at the Management Group level, and all child subscriptions will automatically inherit the policy rules.
questions.explanation: True. Governance policies applied at a Management Group automatically inherit down the hierarchy to child subscriptions.

questions.title: CS2: TF - Azure CLI Command Syntax
questions.prompt: True or False: Azure CLI commands use a Verb-Noun structure such as New-AzVM.
questions.explanation: False. Azure PowerShell uses Verb-Noun cmdlets (e.g. New-AzVM). Azure CLI uses az <group> <action> commands (e.g. az vm create).

questions.title: CS2: TF - Standard HDD Performance
questions.prompt: True or False: Standard HDD magnetic disks deliver sub-millisecond latency for mission-critical SQL databases.
questions.explanation: False. Ultra Disk provides sub-millisecond latency. Standard HDD is magnetic storage designed for non-critical backups.

questions.title: CS2: TF - ARM Central API Layer
questions.prompt: True or False: Every management request initiated from the Azure Portal, Azure CLI, or Azure PowerShell passes through Azure Resource Manager (ARM).
questions.explanation: True. ARM is the central deployment and management service endpoint for all Azure tools and SDKs.
